# tritonctl subnet

Manage subnets

Subcommands: list, show, create, update, delete

Usage: `tritonctl subnet [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl subnet list

List subnets in the project, or in one VPC

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl subnet list [OPTIONS]`

- `--vpc <VPC>`: Only subnets of this VPC (name, uuid, or prefix)

## tritonctl subnet show

Show one subnet

Usage: `tritonctl subnet show [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Subnet name, uuid, or prefix

## tritonctl subnet create

Create a subnet inside a VPC

Usage: `tritonctl subnet create [OPTIONS] --vpc <VPC> --name <NAME>`

- `--vpc <VPC>`: VPC to create it in (name, uuid, or prefix) (required)
- `--name <NAME>` (required)
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`
- `--ipv4-block <IPV4_BLOCK>`: IPv4 CIDR block (one of ipv4-block / ipv6-block required)
- `--ipv6-block <IPV6_BLOCK>`: IPv6 CIDR block
- `--no-ssh-relay`: Create the subnet with SSH access through the relay off

## tritonctl subnet update

Rename a subnet, change its description, or turn its SSH access on or off

Usage: `tritonctl subnet update [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Subnet name, uuid, or prefix
- `--name <NAME>`
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`
- `--ssh-relay <on|off>`: Turn SSH access through the relay on or off (one of: on, off)

## tritonctl subnet delete

Delete a subnet. Refused while NICs still use it

Alias: rm

Usage: `tritonctl subnet delete [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Subnet name, uuid, or prefix
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails
